claims.claim: examples/duplex-streaming/ contains tool-calling scenarios
A scripted persona drives a sustained voice conversation via self-play + TTS
Agent under test can be OpenAI Realtime or Gemini Live
Tool registry executes real handlers, mock-backed for demo
Conversation-level assertions check which tools fired, args, order, results
promptarena serve run from examples/duplex-streaming loads config.arena.yaml and all duplex-streaming scenarios
scenario duplex-tools has a busy-professional persona asking about weather, calendar, reminders, three tools
promptarena run --scenario duplex-tools --provider gemini-2-flash --ci; requires GEMINI_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY
promptarena run --scenario duplex-tools --provider mock-duplex --ci needs no keys: the selfplay-user role uses mock-duplex and the persona voice mock-tts
scenario file path examples/duplex-streaming/scenarios/duplex-tools.scenario.yaml
turn 1 is role user with parts type audio, media.file_path audio/greeting.pcm, mime_type audio/L16
The first turn's content_matches assertion uses params.pattern "(?i)(hello|hi|help|assist|Nova)"
turn role selfplay-user with persona busy-professional and turns: 4
conversation_assertions field
tools_called assertion params tool_names (list) and min_calls
three tools fired at least once over four-turn self-play conversation
tool_calls_with_args and tool_call_sequence can be layered in as conversation assertions
tool_calls_with_args params tool_name and expected_args (map)
expected_args time: "9am" for set_reminder
tool_call_sequence params sequence list of tool names
CI workflow YAML: validate job runs ../../bin/promptarena validate config.arena.yaml in examples/duplex-streaming
go build -o bin/promptarena ./arena/cmd/promptarena
go-version '1.26'
run --scenario duplex-tools --provider gemini-2-flash --ci --formats json,markdown flags
env GEMINI_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY
fork-aware if: check keeps secret job off external fork PRs
mock-duplex provider emits a fixed auto_respond text instead of executing scripted tool calls in mock-responses.yaml
In mock mode mock-duplex replies from the duplex-tools block of mock-responses.yaml with scripted tool_calls, tools execute for real and the three tools_called conversation assertions pass
examples/voice-ivr uses a text-mode mock provider that executes scripted tool calls
No fully-mocked duplex provider scripts both audio output and tool calls
new tool: drop .tool.yaml into tools/, reference in config.arena.yaml, mention in prompts/voice-assistant-tools.prompt.yaml
replace tools_called with tool_calls_with_args and specify expected_args
tools_not_called assertion type exists
